evidence.note: Explicit milestone structure via TaskCreate is coarse: implementation lumped as one task ('all 6 task types'), plus a dataset-structure check and a single 'run all 37 + structural check' task. No per-type sub-goals or per-milestone done-checks in the plan.

In execution the agent validated each task type separately before the full run (STS, then pair classification, classification, summarization, clustering, retrieval) — a de facto split-by-type-and-validate ordering matching the level-5 anchor.
Only after per-type spot-checks did it run all 37 together (85) and review scores by type (174, 221), rather than gating each type on a numeric leaderboard done-check before proceeding.
TaskUpdate transitions track the three coarse milestones to completion; no separate milestones exist for the CLI contract or skip-and-continue behavior.

reasoning: The explicit milestone plan (steps 17-19) is coarse — one undifferentiated 'implement all 6 types' task — which alone would sit near anchor 3, but in execution the agent clearly split work by task type and validated each type before moving to the full run (steps 37-82), matching the level-5 anchor 'splits work by task type and plans to validate each type before moving on, with a rough sense of ordering.' It falls short of 8 because there were no per-milestone done-checks tied to leaderboard agreement baked into the plan, and no distinct milestones for the CLI contract or skip-and-continue harness.
